noEndorsement: A badge describes the specific claim reviewed. It does not endorse posts or statements.
evidenceStandard: Use official public websites, established media or institutional references. Public links are evidence for a reviewer. Do not upload identification documents or share access tokens.
reviewersNeeded: The independent review path needs two eligible reviewers.
founderBlueHelp: Review the evidence and record your reason. Approval grants Identity Verified (blue). Rejection closes the application.
founderRepresentativeHelp: Review the public evidence that this member is authorized to represent the organization. This decision applies only to the member’s current representative role.
founderRepresentativeConfirm: I reviewed the evidence and confirm I’m recording a direct Founder decision.
founderOrgHelp: Review the organization’s public references and record your reason. Approval verifies the organization. Rejection closes the request.
founderOrgConfirm: I confirm that I reviewed the organization’s evidence and am recording a Founder decision.
assignmentRequired: Claim or receive the assignment before viewing evidence and deciding an application.
representativeMeaning: This badge confirms authority for a specific institution and position. It expires when that authority ends.
representativeAlert: Your access to represent an institution has changed.
institutionEvidenceRequired: Provide two or three public HTTPS links from at least two distinct websites.
institutionEvidenceHelp: Use an official registry, regulator, license or appointment notice where applicable. If the organization has no official website, include independent community or partner references. A website listed by an applicant cannot establish authority on its own.
appealWindow: You can appeal a rejection or revocation once within 14 days of the decision.
noAppeals: There are no verification appeals here.
references: Public references (one HTTPS link per line)
noReports: There are no impersonation reports to review.
hold: Temporarily hide a disputed public badge
verifyApplicationAlert: Your verification application has an update.
verifyAppealAlert: Your verification appeal has a decision.
unavailable: This case or review action is unavailable.
appealExists: An appeal already exists for this decision.
emptyAssignments: There are no pending applications to assign.
appealEvidence: Only an independent reviewer may decide this appeal. Reconsideration allows a fresh review and does not restore a badge.
notabilityReferences: Provide at least two independent public references for a public-figure claim.
